hypothesis: Local wave-packet sparsity is wavelength scaled: a window spanning too many wavelengths mixes propagation changes, while a 1.5-wavelength window can expose several coherent local branches.
primary_metric: held-out-pixel local raw complex relative L2 averaged per physical system
promotion_gate: Across three patch seeds, K=4 improves K=1 by at least 15% on partial or closed boundaries with a positive system-bootstrap 95% interval.
interpretation_guard: Passing proves local multi-component representation headroom, not that learned tokens or physically named reflection paths have been recovered.
